CodeEdgeKind.description: Closed predicate vocabulary emitted by the engram-code extractor (RFC-0020 Phase 2, ADR-0028). KnowledgeRelationship.predicate stays an open string; this is the contracted code set.

UnresolvedReferenceStatus.description: Lifecycle of a recorded unresolved cross-file code reference. pending -> resolved (orphan sweep); pending -> failed (operator only); terminal states never change.

UnresolvedReference.description: Recorded best-effort-failed cross-file code reference (the code-resolution honesty ledger). Same lifecycle as relationships: retracted with the referring document on re-ingest, re-attempted by the orphan sweep.

RerankConfig.title: RerankConfig
RerankConfig.description: Reranker selection + parameters. `strategy` reuses the domain RerankStrategy enum (snake_case); engram wires `none`/`mmr`/`cross_encoder` today (the other variants deserialize but are not dispatched).

strategy.description: Which reranker to apply between fusion and budget.

lambda.description: MMR relevance/diversity trade-off in [0, 1] (1 = pure relevance, 0 = max diversity). Only consulted for `strategy = "mmr"`.

RecallFusionConfig.title: RecallFusionConfig
RecallFusionConfig.description: External recall-fusion configuration (RFC-0019). Operator-facing, serializable config loaded from a `[recall_fusion]` profile section or `.engram/recall.json`. Drives weighted reciprocal-rank fusion (vector + lexical + graph + facts + ...) and optional reranking in engram's unified recall. Absent config falls back to equal-weight RRF (today's behavior).

rrf_k.description: RRF constant (>= 1). Lower values make top ranks dominate more aggressively; higher values flatten. Conventional default 60 (Cormack et al. 2009).

default_source_weight.description: Weight applied to any lane source not named in `source_weights`. Default 1.0 (pure RRF when no overrides are set).

source_weights.description: Per-lane-source weight overrides. Keys are the normalized lane source tags (the weight keys): `vector`, `lexical`, `graph`, `associative_graph`, `community_summary`, `temporal`, `facts`, `belief`. A zero weight keeps a source visible for traceability while contributing nothing to its fused score.

rerank.description: Optional reranker selection + parameters. When absent, no reranking is applied (fusion output is the final ranking).

query.description: Query-only format; excluded from passage representation identity.

CodeIntelligenceConfigOverlay.description: Partial overlay. Defaults shown are balanced-v1 annotations; shared profile expansion precedes explicit overrides.

query.description: Runtime enforces at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes before tokenization (schema length is code points).

repository.description: Runtime enforces at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes before tokenization (schema length is code points).

unitId.description: Canonical CodeChunkDescriptor.unit, distinct from KnowledgeChunk.id; never a chunk lookup key.

sourceHash.description: Exact opaque canonical source hash, preserved without relabeling.

generation.description: Exact opaque canonical source-generation identifier; never a numeric counter.

segmentIds.description: Canonical parent inventory order, then ascending first source byte per parent; terminal continuations follow their range.

inputContractId.description: Versioned input order, token preparation and expected output interpretation; included in manifest identity.
